status: normative coordinated safety correction; baseline retained as historical PHP evidence

overrides.rationale: Adoption records actual remote state without overwriting it. Desired-state readiness would be false when actual differs from desired. No implicit update is permitted.

additional_requirements: A blocked or ambiguous real apply invalidates stale readiness; dry-run never writes state.
Persist uncertain mutation intent before issuing a remote write, so process termination cannot enable a blind duplicate mutation.
An ambiguous mutation can resolve only through authoritative matching readback (or confirmed absence for delete); missing or differing readback remains blocked even with recreate/overwrite flags.
